color.note: Warm paper background, a pine green for identity, three 'sticky note' colors for categories and states.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table columns, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: kanban column background, code block, disabled field.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules, card and field borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Identity color: primary action, active state, 'Done'. As text, on surfaces or pine-soft.

tokens.name: pine-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind pine text (a 'Done' badge, a selected card).

tokens.name: on-pine
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a solid pine fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Solid sticky-note yellow: note, idea, 'In progress'. Always with on-sun on top, never as text on the light surface.

tokens.name: sun-text
tokens.usage: Yellow usable as text, on surfaces or sun-soft (warning).

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind sun-text (warning banner, 'In progress' badge).

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on a solid sun fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Blocking, error, risk, deletion. As text, on surfaces or coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind coral text (a 'Blocked' badge).

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on a solid coral fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Information, 'To do', secondary links. As text, on surfaces or sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind sky text (a 'To do' badge, an info callout).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — alias of pine.

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Fredoka: round and joyful, reserved for titles.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Artifact title, once per page or slide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The team delivered 21 points out of 24 planned.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Decision: we keep the daily at 9:30am.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sticky note and field padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutter between columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins, between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room around display titles, slide margins.

radius.note: Generous and soft — nothing has a sharp corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, fields, sticky notes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Table columns, panels, slides.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, chips.

shadow.note: Short, warm shadows, like a sticky note peeling off.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and sticky notes at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Card being dragged, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px page color, then 2px pine.
